answer: The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in river, expire in basalt, and trellis lists each expiry. Anyone running 186 aliases hence needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1857 identities would post 3235 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
